summary.ko: 카탈로그 식물 18283종을 Europe PMC에서 육지거북 용어와 함께 검색해 978종에서 문헌을 찾았고, 오픈액세스 원문 566편에서 학명이 나오는 위치를 확인했습니다. 또한 미국 사막거북 학회 발표집, IUCN 종 설명서, 남미·갈라파고스·마다가스카르·인도양·지중해·중앙아시아 연구와 학위논문 등 문서 61건을 저장해 표와 본문을 확인했습니다. 학명이 원문에 인쇄된 기록만 연결했고, 종 설명서·리뷰를 거친 기록은 1차 연구 미확인으로 표시합니다.
summary.en: 18283 catalog species were searched in Europe PMC together with land-tortoise terms (hits for 978), and the species name was located in 566 open-access full texts. 61 further documents (Desert Tortoise Council proceedings, IUCN species accounts, South American, Galapagos, Madagascar, Indian Ocean, Mediterranean and Central Asian studies and theses) were saved and their tables and text checked. Only names printed in the source are linked; records taken from species accounts or reviews are marked as such (primary study not read).

scope: Feeding, diet, nutrition and toxicity records for catalog species from sources not used in batches 001-002. A record links a plant to a tortoise taxon as printed in the source; it is not a feeding grade and is not generalised to other tortoises.

verification_levels.full_text_verified: original paper, thesis or symposium paper read; the record is in the stated table or passage
verification_levels.review_full_text_verified: read in a review, species account or compilation; the primary study was not read
verification_levels.guideline_full_text_verified: read in a professional husbandry guideline
verification_levels.literature_lead_not_reverified: only a title or citation was seen
verification_levels.community_report_unverified: keeper, forum or informant report; a reference, not verified research
verification_levels.video_observation_unverified: feeding as stated in a public video's title or description
